## 2026-07-20

### Impact

- Apps that launch Transact more than once no longer have their callback receivers overridden. Multiple Transact instances can now run without one clobbering another's callbacks, so results are delivered reliably to the correct handler.

### Changes

- Added support for the `account` deeplink step with an accompanying `accountId`, allowing apps to deep link directly to an Account/Merchant page
- Support for multiple Transact instances without overriding each other's callback receivers

### Products

- Manage

### Requirements

#### Latest

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 2.0+       | 2.1.21        |
| Gradle     | 8.11.1+    | 8.14.2        |
| AGP        | 8.9+       | 8.9.1         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |

#### Legacy (`-kotlin1.9`)

| Name       | Compatible | Build Version |
| ---------- | ---------- | ------------- |
| Kotlin     | 1.9.x      | 1.9.25        |
| Gradle     | 8.0+       | 8.7           |
| AGP        | 8.1 - 8.5  | 8.1.4         |
| Min SDK    | 23         | 23            |
| Target SDK | 35         | 35            |
